name: pii-redact-sweep
goal: Find every API response that returns customer PII (email, phone, SSN, date of birth) without going through redact() first, for a compliance report

lanes.prompt: Read {item} in {root}. It is an Express-style route handler that may return customer data (email, phone, SSN, date of birth) in a JSON response. Trace every response call (res.json, res.send) in this file back to where the response body is built. If any field carrying email, phone, ssn/social-security, or dob/date-of-birth data reaches the response WITHOUT first passing through the redact() function exported from src/lib/redact.js, report one finding: ref = this file, severity = 'critical' if ssn or dob are exposed unredacted, else 'high', title = a short, CONSISTENT phrase for the defect pattern so identical defects share the exact same title (e.g. "raw customer object returned without redact()"), evidence = the exact quoted line(s) showing the unredacted response. If every PII-bearing object in this file's response already passes through redact() before res.json/res.send, or the file returns no PII, return findings: [].

Sweep {item} under {root}. Confirm whether ANY code path there (an exported function whose return value a route handler sends directly via res.json/res.send, a service or job that builds a response payload, a model helper other than customer()) can put customer PII (email, phone, ssn, dob) into an API response without it passing through redact() from src/lib/redact.js first. List every file you actually opened as part of your evidence, not just the ones with a defect. If you find a leak outside src/routes/, report one finding per distinct leak pattern (ref, severity per the same critical/high rule as the routes lane, title using consistent wording, evidence = quoted lines). If nothing outside src/routes/ can leak PII into a response, return findings: [] and note in the finding-less case which files you inspected by putting that file list as the evidence on a single 'info' severity finding titled "no additional response-building PII paths found" with ref = {item}.
items: src/services/**, src/jobs/**, src/models/**, and src/lib/** (every file outside src/routes/)

synth.prompt: Write this for a compliance lead, not an engineer. Lead with a one-paragraph plain-language summary: which fields leak, how many endpoints, and that a working fix (redact()) already exists and is used correctly elsewhere in the codebase. Then a table of every confirmed finding: route/file, PII fields exposed, severity, one-line fix (call redact() on the object before res.json). Then briefly list what was checked and cleared (the compliant routes and the non-route sweep) so the lead can see the sweep was thorough, not just the bad news. Then run accounting: agents spent by tier, ceiling, rounds, anything dropped.
